subject: mathematics
question_text: If f(x) = 2, g(x) = x² and h(x) = 2x for all x ∈ R, find (fo(goh))(x).

mark_split.label: Value of f at that expression

verification.note: Source: Sri Chaitanya, FAST TRACK IPE for Jr. Students — Mathematics-IA (2026-27 edition), book p.10, chapter 2 FUNCTIONS, Very Short Answer question 10(i). Only the question was taken. The solution, the step order and the mark split are this answer book's own work — see docs/ORIGINALITY_MATHS.md. ⚠ THE MARK SPLIT IS OURS, NOT THE BOOK'S: the Mathematics-IA volume prints no per-step mark allocation on any answer. The 1+1 shape gives one mark to the inner composition (goh)(x) = 4x² and one to seeing that a constant function returns 2 whatever it is given. WHAT THE BOOK PRINTS: the stem is printed as (fo(goh)(x)), which is one closing bracket short. We authored the only reading that parses, (fo(goh))(x) — f applied to the composition g o h. Paper position: Maths-1A Section A runs Q1–Q10 at 2 marks each, all compulsory. This is a coaching publication, not a TSBIE document, so the split stays unverified until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it.

recall_prompt: Say how you would find (fo(goh))(x) — the order the three functions act in, and why the answer is a single number.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Work the inner pair g o h
steps.margin_note: First mark. h is innermost, so h acts first and g squares its output. Getting (goh)(x) = 4x² earns this mark on its own.
steps.memory_tip: Work from the inside out: h first, then g, then f.
lines: h is innermost, so h acts first, then g.

recall.must_convey: That h acts first giving 2x, and g squares it, so (goh)(x) = 4x².
accept: h acts first giving two x then g squares it so g o h of x is four x squared
g of two x is two x whole squared which is four x squared
the inner composition is four x squared
modata h apply chesthe two x vastundi appudu g square chestundi four x squared
square two x to get four x squared

steps.why: The brackets say g o h is worked out first, and inside that pair h is the inner function. Squaring 2x squares both the 2 and the x, which is why the coefficient is 4 and not 2.
common_mistakes: Writing (2x)² as 2x², squaring only the x.
Taking g first and computing h(x²) = 2x².

steps.label: Apply the constant function f
steps.margin_note: Second mark. State that f is a constant function before writing the answer — that sentence is what shows the 4x² was understood and then correctly ignored.
steps.memory_tip: A constant function ignores its input. Whatever goes in, 2 comes out.
lines: f is the constant function f(x) = 2,
so f(t) = 2 for every real number t.

recall.must_convey: That f is a constant function, so f of 4x² is 2 and the whole composition is the constant 2.
accept: f is a constant function so f of four x squared is two
whatever you put into f you get two so the answer is two
f takes every input to two so the composition is two
f constant function kabatti input em ichina two ye vastundi
reject: the answer is four x squared

steps.why: f has the same value 2 at every input, so the expression 4x² never reaches the answer. The composition is itself a constant function, which is why the answer carries no x.
common_mistakes: Writing f(4x²) = 4x², treating f as the identity function.
Writing f(4x²) = 8x², treating f(x) = 2 as multiply by 2.
